description: This file contains a migration class for version 5.0 of the OrangeHRM system. It defines an 'up' method that applies various schema changes, data insertions, configuration adjustments, and localization updates essential for migrating the database schema and data during an upgrade process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Migration class for version 5.0 of OrangeHRM, extending AbstractMigration to implement database schema and data changes during system upgrade.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs all database schema modifications, data insertions, configuration updates, and localization handling needed for migrating to version 5.0.

methods.name: configureTimeMenuItemsIfTimesheetStartDateDefined
methods.description: Enables or disables menu items under 'Time' based on the presence of a timesheet start date configuration.

methods.name: configureLeaveMenuItemsIfLeavePeriodDefined
methods.description: Enables or disables menu items under 'Leave' depending on whether the leave period is defined.

methods.name: configureMenuItems
methods.description: Handles enabling or disabling menu items based on a configuration value, by updating menu item status in the database.

methods.name: addTimezoneColumnsToAttendanceRecord
methods.description: Adds timezone-related columns to the attendance records table and initializes them with appropriate offsets.

methods.name: updateMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Updates the menu configurator class URL for specific modules and screens.

methods.name: updateModuleDisplayNames
methods.description: Updates display names for various modules in the system.

methods.name: insertI18nGroups
methods.description: Inserts predefined internationalization groups into the database for localization features.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LangStringHelper for handling language strings.

methods.name: getTranslationHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of TranslationHelper for handling translations.

methods.name: cleanUniqueIdTable
methods.description: Cleans up entries in the unique ID table, excluding 'hs_hr_employee'.

methods.name: hideAddonMenuItems
methods.description: Hides specific addon menu items like 'Claim' and 'LDAP Configuration' by setting their status to false.
